_comment: Replace mock_psu/mock_relay entries with real hardware once ready. For a SCPI instrument use device_type 'scpi' with kwargs {'command_map_path': 'drivers_config/my_instrument.json'}. For the Seeit relay use device_type 'seeit_relay08' with kwargs {'serial_port': 'COM5'}. For an Aim-TTi PSU use device_type 'aimtti_psu' with kwargs {'serial_port': 'COM5', 'num_channels': 1 or 2}.
